title: Theorem 4: explicit E8 optimal radial Schwartz function with Fourier signs and nonvanishing
statement_scope: For g(x) := (π i / 8640) a(x) + (i / (240 π)) b(x), the theorem asserts conditions (eqn:g1)--(eqn:g3): g(x) ≤ 0 for ||x|| ≥ √2, ĝ(x) ≥ 0 for all x ∈ R^8, and g(0) = ĝ(0) = 1; moreover g(x) and ĝ(x) do not vanish for all vectors x with ||x||^2 ∉ 2Z_{>0}. Complete original statement; the referenced conditions are defined at lines 114-122.
